title: TypeScript Core Language and Professional Practice Assessment

recommended_settings.attempts: Follow CodeLeaf exam policy; this blueprint does not alter live attempt limits.

assessment_type: Mixed single-choice knowledge assessment plus human-reviewed practical capstone.
outcomes: Explain compile-time type checking and runtime behavior.
Use the core type system, functions, objects, narrowing, interfaces and generics.
Configure modules/compiler settings and explain runtime environment boundaries.
Design runtime validation, typed APIs, tests, error handling and secure workflows.
Plan a maintainable application/library and document release/migration assumptions.

topic_distribution.focus: Foundations, setup, JavaScript, syntax and fundamental types.
Arrays, objects, functions, narrowing, interfaces and generics.
Advanced types, classes, modules and build configuration.
Runtime APIs, asynchronous work, validation, tooling, testing and declarations.
Architecture, role-specific development, security, performance, migration and capstone planning.

remediation: Review linked lessons for missed outcomes and submit a revised explanation or practical artifact. Passing a knowledge check alone does not certify real deployment readiness.
